periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: High-contrast eye patches are angled at approximately 45 degrees relative to the horizontal axis, converging towards the snout.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Vertically elongated oval morphology with a height-to-width ratio of approximately 1.6:1.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Pronounced downward tapering where the patch width narrows significantly from the geometric center toward the inferior pole.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: Posterior edge of the dark transverse band exhibits a shallow U-shape profile across the dorsal midline.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: The dark band is thick, occupying approximately 30-35% of the visible dorsal-ventral torso height at the lateral flanks.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Wide lateral separation, with the inter-pinna gap being approximately 1.5 times the horizontal width of a single pinna.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Superior margins of the pinnae exhibit smooth, continuous convex curvature with no visible flattening.

other_distinctive_markers: Distinctive brownish-yellow staining visible on the fur of the lower ventral abdominal and pelvic regions.
